{{Quote|I've done my share of perimeter runs. X-87 models?|[[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Meteor]], to [[Tre Nareves]]|<ref name="TOR:Goodwill">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Goodwill|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
The '''X-87 model''' was a model of a perimeter beacon in use during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Tre Nareves]] offered a set of them to the settlers of the [[Chuaro Farmstead]].<ref name="TOR:Goodwill" />
